data.long_meaning: Ateeqa is a name that signifies a strong connection with Allah, implying a pious and devout individual. It is a name that reflects a deep sense of spirituality and morality. The name Ateeqa carries the meaning “Pious and Devout” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ateeqa usually hope their child will grow to embody pious and devout and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Ateeqa

in_english.long_meaning: The name Ateeqa originates from the Arabic root 'ع-ت-ق' (ʿ-t-q), which conveys the meaning of 'ancient' or 'old'. In Islamic tradition, this name may signify a person of noble and venerable character. It may also imply a connection to the past or a sense of timelessness. Historically, the term 'atique' (عتيق) has been used to describe something or someone that is old and revered.
